ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition, Advertising and CS+ADV majors on Monday, April 18, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Ag Production & Processing, Construction Management, Digital & Precision Ag, Energy and the Environment, French Commercial, Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, April 25, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. No exceptions will be made. BADM 320 is offered online in the summer and winter terms as well as this fall term. An online section of this course is also offered in the spring semester with an enrollment limit. There are currently 15 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 26, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Food Science & Human Nutrition or Business Undeclared or Accountancy or Finance or Industrial Engineering or Advertising or Marketing or French Commercial Studies or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Systems Engineering and Design or Information Systems or Operations Management or Computer Science & Advertising or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Ag Production & Processing or Construction Management or Digital & Precision Ag or Energy and the Environment major(s) or minor(s).
